### Load required libraries
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(skimr)
```

### Load the dataset
```{r}
raw_data <- read_delim("clinical_dataset.tsv", 
                       delim = "\t", 
                       na = c("NA", "Unknown", "unknown", "NA ", ""),
                       trim_ws = TRUE)
```

### Clean column names
```{r}
data_clean <- raw_data %>% clean_names()
```


### w
```{r}
# --- CHUNK 2: Cleaning Pipeline ---
processed_data <- data_clean %>%
  # 1. Demographics: Handle Age and Sex
  mutate(
    current_age = as.numeric(current_age),
    sex = as.factor(sex)
  ) %>%
  
  # 2. Target Variable: Predict primary response (Survival as proxy)
  # We convert "0:LIVING" to a clean factor
  mutate(
    survival_status = case_when(
      str_detect(overall_survival_status, "0:LIVING") ~ "Living",
      str_detect(overall_survival_status, "1:DECEASED") ~ "Deceased",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ 
    ),
    survival_status = as.factor(survival_status)
  ) %>%
  
  # 3. Clinical Features: Clean the Stage (NLP-derived)
  # This fixes the quality issues where stages are inconsistently logged
  mutate(
    clean_stage = case_when(
      str_detect(stage_highest_recorded, "Stage 1-3") ~ "Early/Intermediate",
      str_detect(stage_highest_recorded, "Stage 4") ~ "Advanced/Metastatic",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown/Other"
    ),
    clean_stage = as.factor(clean_stage)
  ) %>%
  
  # 4. Handle NLP Binary Fields (Yes/No to 1/0)
  # This cleans columns like tumor_site_bone_nlp
  mutate(across(contains("_nlp"), ~case_when(
    . == "Yes" ~ 1,
    . == "No" ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ 0 # Assuming No if not specified, or keep as NA depending on your logic
  ))) %>%
  
  # 5. Final Row Filtering
  # Remove rows where our primary predictors or target are still NA
  filter(!is.na(survival_status), !is.na(current_age))

# Check: How many NAs are left in our key columns?
miss_scan <- processed_data %>% 
  select(current_age, sex, survival_status, clean_stage) %>% 
  summarise_all(~sum(is.na(.)))

print(miss_scan)

processed_data
```
